newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 1996/97 motorcycle output down 3.2% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan 1996/97 motorcycle output down 3.2% yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's motorcycle production fell 3.2 percent in 1996/97 from a year earlier to 2,587,842 units, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers' Association (JAMA) said on Friday.
It was the fourth straight yearly decline.

The 1996/97 output included 24 motorcycles made by smaller makers against 134 a year earlier.
Domestic motorcycle sales in 1996/97 rose 1.3 percent from a year earlier to 1,227,109, the second straight yearly gain.
JAMA said it expected Japanese motorcycle exports in 1996/97 to have risen about two percent from a year earlier.
JAMA will announce official export figures on April 28.
